tests_hardware/device_scripts/heap_under: a bench serving script: it boots main() and holds its maps while the host's bench test drives the connection load, so alone in the twin it runs past the record's 60 s bound (its twin runs at -1 and 32768: about 112 s each, READY once, zero allocation failures)
tests_hardware/device_scripts/serving_at: a bench serving script: it boots main() and waits for the host's request sweep, which only the bench tier sends, so alone in the twin it runs past the record's 60 s bound (its twin runs at -1 and 32768: about 622 s each, webserver built, phases incomplete without the sweep, zero allocation failures)
tests_hardware/device_scripts/uart_link_: a bench serving script: the multi-chunk echo needs the bench board's UART jumper under main()'s own link and the host's reader load, so alone in the twin it runs past the record's 60 s bound (its twin runs at -1 and 32768: about 192 s each, the initiator found, zero allocation failures)
